result.markdown:
The best HR software for a small company depends on your employee numbers, whether you need payroll included, and how much HR administration you want to automate.

**My recommendation: If you're a small business in Australia, I'd start by comparing Employment Hero, BambooHR and Deputy.** They serve slightly different needs, and choosing the right one can save you a lot of administrative work.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![Employment Hero Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Z6qVhSSYF5CYFaR38tVZ9vpu364SrI1qcU-LhtFo5MrKvM2IIECP5NGDLvCA9qSi3OHN3nIGoWj3sOAoSGJ3TbpMzqye4Jq3Q2-1Ae4X05g3VDo154uJn7RkzUUAY3Xfi51rzm16rZPnUZ2NnrKj1KHaQU4ePGT94fhowd8mNNeyff58VJ3Le5GJh2e89NE4?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Employment Hero**

(Best overall for Australian businesses)

- Employee records and onboarding
- Leave and attendance management
- Employment contracts and HR documents
- Payroll and compliance capabilities
- Employee self-service

Best if you want an integrated HR platform designed for Australian employment requirements.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best for HR management)

- Employee database
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- Leave management
- Reporting and analytics

Best if you want a polished, easy-to-use HR system. Check Australian payroll integration requirements.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Deputy Reviews & Ratings 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qoByH159DzYjIg5JFSgJe_CrrOf-wWpu0NxcOvG6wnNrWxUBp2pWvfKDJQuLKEciskXUB50dz7epp-QNK4O5lRW4JRHb__rqNnriStFV61xGFgMa-0v3cr14yjduhrlUciR7igDAF9SaZLY-M41tItck4weErSvaE3c997IXnQHRZf-nNs4EzZWkpNLf1VnF?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Deputy**

(Best for rostering and hourly staff)

- Employee scheduling
- Timesheets and attendance
- Shift swapping
- Leave management
- Labour cost tracking

Best for hospitality, retail, healthcare and businesses with shift workers.

[Deputy website](https://www.deputy.com/au)

---

![Rippling Company Profile Funding & Investors | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SAzMvIL6PtbUMLb8gBTabCeVnrSEXbTwCT-aC0SC4jJFQ74dXv0idEYA-gW8Xf4QyVq2JUnFjv2iQman7uk3D8kUDVp4a4whGwY7X8hxbhcNKKU6eqdr0HQC44Yinb10-d1Qx8pYpUGPKlk3izjNGAFETr0jiBpGuRO01GQ7GCiUG98Lat9yOYtjvREa50cA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Rippling**

- HR and employee administration
- Onboarding automation
- IT and software access management
- Payroll options
- Workflow automation

Best for fast-growing companies wanting to automate multiple business functions.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho People**

- Employee records
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management
- Customisable workflows

Best for businesses looking for an affordable HR management system.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

## My comparison

| Software | Main strength | Ideal company |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Employment Hero | Complete HR platform | 5–100 employees |
| BambooHR | HR administration | 10–100 employees |
| Deputy | Rostering and timesheets | 5–100 employees |
| Rippling | Automation and IT | Growing businesses |
| Zoho People | Affordability | 1–50 employees |


These are indicative fits rather than hard employee limits. Employment Hero is also highlighted for Australian SMEs in TechRadar's 2026 comparison. [www.techradar.com](https://www.techradar.com/best/best-hr-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[technologyadvice.com](https://technologyadvice.com/blog/human-resources/best-hr-software-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[fitsmallbusiness.com](https://fitsmallbusiness.com/best-hris-hrms-software-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before buying

For a small Australian company, I'd prioritise\:

1. Employee records and secure document storage.
2. Digital onboarding and employment contracts.
3. Leave requests and approvals.
4. Performance reviews and probation tracking.
5. Training and compliance records.
6. Payroll integration with Australian award and superannuation requirements.
7. Easy reporting and employee self-service.

## Let me narrow it down to the best option

There are three things that would help me make a much more accurate recommendation.

**1\. How many employees does your company have?**

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
